description_en: Invokes the UnassociateHaVip operation to disassociate a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip) from an ECS instance or network interface controller (NIC) in a virtual private cloud (VPC)
description_zh: 调用UnassociateHaVip 接口将HaVip与专有网络ECS实例或弹性网卡解绑
kebab_example: aliyun vpc unassociate-ha-vip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ha-vip-id havip-2zeo05qre24nhrqpy0000 --instance-id i-faf344422ffsfad0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassociateHaVip

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The `ClientToken` value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the HaVip.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
HaVip所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HaVip to be disassociated
parameters.name: ha_vip_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance or network interface controller (NIC) to disassociate HaVip from
parameters.help_zh: 与HaVip解绑的ECS实例ID或弹性网卡实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully disassociate HaVip from the ECS instance or network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:

True: forcefully disassociates the instance.

False (default): does not forcefully disassociate the instance.

If this parameter is set to False, the primary instance attached to the HaVip cannot be disassociated
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制解绑与HaVip绑定的ECS实例或弹性网卡实例，取值：

True：强制解绑。

False （默认值）：不强制解绑。

如果该参数取值为False，无法解绑HaVip绑定的主实例
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance to disassociate HaVip from. Valid values:

EcsInstance: ECS instance.

NetworkInterface: network interface controller (NIC) instance.

This parameter is required when the instance to be disassociated is a network interface controller (NIC) instance
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑HaVip的实例类型，取值：

EcsInstance：云服务器ECS实例。

NetworkInterface：弹性网卡实例。

当要解绑的实例为弹性网卡时，该参数必须填写
parameters.name: instance_type
